items.title: Harry Fairconnetue Interview, 1962-11-11
items.q: INTERVIEWEE: ...Who inspired you? I mean, look, who you saw playing drums that made you want to play drums? John Benoit. John Benoit. John Benoit.

ctx.x: 1907. That's right. You were pretty close to Harold then. Yeah. Two years old then. Two years old then. I see. And what's the very first music you remember? Any singing or playing or anything you heard?

Well, the singing, it just came natural in the family because all of us sing. Mm-hmm. That was the first. And my first remembrance was playing drums. Oh really? As a real youngster then. Who inspired you? I mean, look, who you saw playing drums that made you want to play drums? John Benoit. John Benoit. John Benoit.

items.title: Harry Fairconnetue Interview, 1962-11-11
items.q: He and I, two altos, Benny Benoit and Banjo.

ctx.x: Oh yeah, he stayed with them for a while.
I mean Cuckoo and Big Ike, you know. He and I, two altos, Benny Benoit and Banjo. Oh yeah.
Tell me about that time, Harold, I gotta get this done, about that drink of whiskey. We were talking about on the way over here, about this man wanting you to drink with him.
